Tazeem kar ke, sab ko bataya Rasool ne.
Har ek Nabi ki Qibla o Kaaba hai Fatema.

1
Jo marzi e Khuda ke siwa boltey nahi.
Woh keh rahey hai, umm e Abiha hai Fatema.

2
Buniyad e Lailah hai, Do nuqta e Noor.
Ek hai Ali to Dusra Nuqta hai Fatema.

3
Soon kar jisey wujud may aayi hai Qaenat.
Woh lafzey Kun hai, jiska khulasa hai Fatema..

4
Parhtey hai jisko Roj Patangey Namaz may.
Woh Halley mushkilat ka wajeefa hai Fatema.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/roh-rsol.md')
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in yaml.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines())
for text, numbers in ((roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')):
    blocks = text.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 5
    assert len(blocks[0].splitlines()) == 2
    for block, number in zip(blocks[1:], numbers):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) == 3 and lines[0] == number
    assert not any(line.endswith('.') for line in text.splitlines())
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in yaml and 'noUrdu' not in yaml
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body in [roh-rsol.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/9aaacbff040d4265ad47b44622ec6cfb/src/data/lyrics/roh-rsol.md) and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`, preserving its wording and normalizing capitalization and verse endings. Verified that both versions have a two-verse opening and four numbered couplets.

Read “Lailah” as `لا الٰہ` and “Halley mushkilat” as `حلِ مشکلات`. Added the Roman title, set right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.
